description: Give the iOS Simulator a camera, and choose what it shows. Use this before testing anything that opens a camera — a QR or barcode scanner, document capture, an avatar picker. `barcode` generates the code from text, so testing a scanner needs no printed code and no second device; pdf417 is the barcode on a driver's licence. `screen` points the phone's camera at this Mac's screen. Needs no Buoy integration in the app under test.

value.description: Text for `barcode`, a file path for `image`/`video`, a camera uniqueId for `camera` (see `camera_inputs`), or one of `behind` / `display` / `window:<id>` / `region:<id>[:<gutter>]` for `screen`.

name: camera_source
